description: This file implements a plugin for device pairing in the OpenClaw system, providing QR code and setup code generation, messaging, and device bootstrap token management.

methods.name: renderQrDataUrl
methods.description: Generates a data URL for a QR code image from input data.

methods.name: writeQrPngTempFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary PNG file with QR code data and returns its path.

methods.name: formatDurationMinutes
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a human-readable string in minutes.

methods.name: normalizeUrl
methods.description: Normalizes a raw URL string, applying scheme fallback if necessary.

methods.name: parseNormalizedGatewayUrl
methods.description: Parses and normalizes a gateway URL, ensuring it has ws or wss scheme.

methods.name: resolveScheme
methods.description: Determines WebSocket scheme based on configuration and options.

methods.name: parseIPv4Octets
methods.description: Parses an IPv4 address string into octets.

methods.name: isPrivateIPv4
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address is in private network ranges.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address is in the Tailnet range.

methods.name: pickMatchingIPv4
methods.description: Selects an IPv4 address matching a predicate from network interfaces.

methods.name: pickLanIPv4
methods.description: Selects a LAN IPv4 address.

methods.name: pickTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Selects a Tailnet IPv4 address.

methods.name: resolveTailnetHost
methods.description: Resolves the Tailnet host using a plugin command.

methods.name: resolveAuthLabel
methods.description: Determines the authentication label (token or password) based on configuration.

methods.name: pickFirstDefined
methods.description: Returns the first non-empty string from candidates.

methods.name: resolveRequiredAuthLabel
methods.description: Ensures the required auth label (token or password) is configured.

methods.name: resolveGatewayUrl
methods.description: Resolves the gateway URL based on configuration, environment, and network state.

methods.name: encodeSetupCode
methods.description: Encodes setup payload into a URL-safe base64 string.

methods.name: buildPairingFlowLines
methods.description: Builds instructions for the pairing flow.

methods.name: buildSecurityNoticeLines
methods.description: Builds security notice lines for setup or QR code.

methods.name: buildQrFollowUpLines
methods.description: Builds follow-up instructions after QR code scanning.

methods.name: formatSetupReply
methods.description: Formats the setup code message with instructions and security notices.

methods.name: formatSetupInstructions
methods.description: Formats instructions for setup code with expiration info.

methods.name: buildQrInfoLines
methods.description: Builds informational lines for QR code display.

methods.name: formatQrInfoMarkdown
methods.description: Formats QR code info as markdown.

methods.name: canSendQrPngToChannel
methods.description: Checks if QR PNG can be sent to a specific channel.

methods.name: resolveQrReplyTarget
methods.description: Resolves the target recipient for QR reply based on context.

methods.name: issuesPairSetupCode
methods.description: Determines if a setup code should be issued for an action.

methods.name: issueSetupPayload
methods.description: Issues a new setup payload with bootstrap token.

methods.name: sendQrPngToSupportedChannel
methods.description: Sends a QR PNG image to a supported communication channel.
